# Florence 1490 – Computing, control & information theory

K = knowledge level · use = none/wrong/partial/correct · make = producibility with local means · accept = acceptance.

- **Algorithm (exact step-by-step procedure)** [`algorithm_concept`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/algorithm_concept.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept high. Abacus masters teach explicit procedures through rules and worked examples. A pupil can follow a calculation step by step and check the result. Local: abacus schools (botteghe d'abbaco).
- **Binary numbers** [`binary_numbers`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/binary_numbers.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Doubling and halving are taught as separate operations of arithmetic. Counting with two digits looks like a pointless game.
- **Boolean logic (algebra of true and false)** [`boolean_logic`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/boolean_logic.md) — K1, use none, make easy, accept low. Logic means Aristotle's syllogisms and Peter of Spain, argued in Latin words. Llull's combining wheels are the nearest idea of mechanical reasoning. Local: Giovanni Pico della Mirandola (knows Llull's art); university of Pisa.
- **Switching circuits and logic gates** [`logic_gates_switching`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/logic_gates_switching.md) — K0, use none, make very-hard, accept low
- **Mechanical calculator** [`mechanical_calculator`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/mechanical_calculator.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept high. Clockmakers can cut the wheels; a reliable carry across several digits is the hard part. Merchants would pay, abacus masters would sneer. Local: Lorenzo della Volpaia; clockmakers.
- **Punched cards for control and data** [`punched_card_control`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/punched_card_control.md) — K1, use none, make hard, accept medium. Pegged barrels drive clock chimes and automata. On silk drawlooms the pattern is tied in cords and pulled by a drawboy. Local: Arte della Seta (silk guild); drawloom weavers. Elsewhere: Low Countries, mechanical clock chimes.
- **Programmable computer (stored program)** [`programmable_computer`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/programmable_computer.md) — K0, use none, make impossible, accept low

An abacus master can execute a transition table on a marked paper strip. Explaining universality and the limits of calculation is the harder task.

Casting out nines lets abacus pupils detect some copying and calculation errors. The check neither locates an error nor recovers the original number. Local: abacus schools; merchant bookkeepers.
- **Packet switching and computer networks** [`packet_switching_networks`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/packet_switching_networks.md) — K0, use none, make impossible, accept low
- **Feedback control (governor, negative feedback)** [`feedback_control`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/feedback_control.md) — K1, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Hero's float valve is in the Pneumatica; millers let the shaking hopper feed grain by the stone's speed. Furnaces are regulated by a watching apprentice. Local: millers; alchemists' furnaces.
- **Cryptography and codebreaking (ciphers, frequency analysis, one-time pad)** [`cryptography`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/cryptography.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept high. Florentine chanceries use substitution and code lists. Alberti described a cipher disc around 1467. Its routine adoption in Florence is undocumented. Local: chancery of the Signoria; Medici bank correspondents. Elsewhere: Milan, Sforza chancery (Cicco Simonetta's rules for breaking ciphers, 1474); Venice; papal curia.
- **Public-key cryptography and digital signatures** [`public_key_cryptography`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/public_key_cryptography.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept low. An abacus master can demonstrate the arithmetic with small numbers. Key sizes suited to confidential diplomatic traffic would make hand calculation impractical.
